description: This script generates database documentation data from engine spec metadata, outputs JSON files for React components, and creates MDX pages for each database and overview. It also extracts metadata via AST parsing, runs external Python scripts, and manages related assets like logos and README updates.

methods.name: tryRunFullScript
methods.description: Attempts to run a Python script with Flask context to get detailed database docs; falls back if fails.

methods.name: extractEngineSpecMetadata
methods.description: Runs a Python AST parser to extract metadata from engine spec files, supporting inheritance and class attribute evaluation.

methods.name: buildStatistics
methods.description: Builds statistical summaries from the database documentation data.

methods.name: toSlug
methods.description: Converts database names into URL-friendly slugs.

methods.name: generateDatabaseMDX
methods.description: Creates MDX content for individual database documentation pages.

methods.name: generateIndexMDX
methods.description: Creates MDX content for the main databases overview page.

methods.name: generateReadmeLogos
methods.description: Generates HTML for database logos to embed in README.md.

methods.name: updateReadme
methods.description: Updates README.md with generated database logos between specific markers.

methods.name: extractCustomErrors
methods.description: Runs a Python script to extract custom error definitions from engine specs.

methods.name: mergeCustomErrors
methods.description: Incorporates custom error info into database documentation data.

methods.name: loadExistingData
methods.description: Loads existing database documentation JSON data if available.

methods.name: mergeWithExistingDiagnostics
methods.description: Preserves diagnostic info from existing data when regenerating documentation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main orchestrator function that generates, updates, and cleans documentation files and assets.
